dedupe_keys.name: peru national mining cadastre catastro minero ingemmet geocatmin

description: The national cadastre of mining rights in Peru. The open data portal and the GEOIDEP metadata record say that INGEMMET publishes the mining rights of the country, that the cadastre is updated daily through the SIDEMCAT system, and that the data can be downloaded as zipped shapefiles by UTM zone (WGS84 17S, 18S and 19S) and viewed in the GEOCATMIN map. The metadata date is 18 February 2025 and the use constraint is stated as restricted and for reference only. The downloads are free. Coverage is Peru. Caveats: the cadastre is referential and not a legal record, per the use constraint. For simulation it shows where mining rights cluster near roads, water sources and communities, for planning mining infrastructure and assessing hazard exposure of mining areas. A related catalogue record is the WRI mining concessions dataset.
